title: 3 Positive Asymmetric Buys From The Bets Quadrant...
creator: Sven Carlin
summary: Sven Carlin updates the "bets" side of his value-investing quadrant with three positive asymmetric risk/reward ideas, stressing these are bets, not margin-of-safety value investments. On Lululemon he details Michael Burry's tax-loss harvest (bought ~$200, sold everything at a ~50% loss after a one-day rotation into Deckers, likely back in January after the 30-day wash rule) and argues nothing happens for 45-60 days: wait ~3 months, watch for year-end tax-loss selling and the new CEO's likely kitchen-sink first call. His three bets: Kuaishou (P/E 7, 400M daily users, Kling AI IPO next year with Hogue's 68% stake worth ~HKD 12B against a legacy business valued near HKD 4B), Pinduoduo ($107B market cap, $66B cash -> ~4x P/E ex-cash, investing RMB 100B to build a third business), and Charter Communications (~3x free cash flow on an adjusted $16B market cap, a 2x if rates turn but saddled with $120B of refinancing risk). He explicitly rejects Uber ("no Uber for me" - no moat, acquisition-fueled growth), Adobe (slow AI-driven decline), Google ("no way Jose"), Birkenstock (quality deterioration anecdote plus PE ownership change), and Petrobras drilling (squeeze bet he no longer takes). Tencent Music moves from the bets quadrant to his investment quadrant. He walks through Mohnish Pabrai's concentrated bucket bets (Transocean/Valaris rigs, Mark Leonard/Constellation, Turkey, coal, India financials) as idea sources he is mostly too uncomfortable to take, and notes Alibaba only gets interesting below $100 (sold his last at $175). Calls: KUAIS/PDD/CHTR CONDITIONAL_BUY (KUAIS softened from Oct 2 BUY; PDD upgraded from UNCERTAIN); BIRK/UBER/GOOGL/ADBE/PBR AVOID; LULU/BABA UNCERTAIN; KSPI HOLD (owned). Auto-captions garble names (Pabrai as "Pabry", Kling as "Cling", Kuaishou as "Quao").
